title: Virtual Compute: assisted credit handling scope
content:
## Scope and evidence

Virtual Compute assisted credit scope. This policy applies only to the assisted primary correction package; link the original charge and its approved arithmetic review. The final target defined here supersedes the pre-concession review target, so achieving it completes the correction and implies no further correction. Within the assisted primary correction package, the same-entity active support combination determines the successive pricing adjustment and settlement concession described here in addition to request-channel eligibility; approval authority remains unchanged. A promotional primary-price entitlement remains suppressed wherever commitment pricing covers the same quantity; the two explicitly described same-entity support reductions are permitted successive adjustments, and no other cross-category benefit is stacked. For the primary credit action, evidence event reference and related evidence reference both identify the approved incorrect arithmetic review of the original primary charge.
